lines.text: The original super glue claims one drop lifts a ton so he puts one drop of 6 brands on steel bolts.
Then he pushes each bolt sideways and Gorilla snaps off at just 15 pounds.
That's nowhere near a ton because he pushes at the tip of a 4 inch bolt which acts like a lever on that tiny drop.
beats: ai:a single tiny bead of clear super glue on the head of a steel bolt extreme macro
ai:a long steel bolt glued flat to a steel bar being pushed sideways at its tip close up

lines.text: And Scotch wins at 36 pounds which is more than double Gorilla.
Next he twists the bolts with a torque wrench and Krazy Glue lets go at just 40 inch pounds.
But Elmer's holds 90 so the brand famous for school glue beats Krazy Glue at its own game.
beats: ai:a plain unlabeled white bottle of school glue on a classroom desk next to colored paper

lines.text: Then he pulls each bolt up with a lever that multiplies his pull 20 times because no arm can do 600 pounds.
And Loctite wins with 616 pounds while Scotch which won the first test only manages 266.
On PVC pipe every other glue snaps under a 25 pound weight but Loctite survives the whole round.
So he adds plates and it holds 40 pounds which is 60 percent more than broke the rest.
So which super glue would you grab?
